title: OR in Matrix
statementMd:
Let's define logical $*OR*$ as an operation on two logical values (i. e. values that belong to the set ${0, 1}$) that is equal to $1$ if either or both of the logical values is set to $1$, otherwise it is $0$. We can define logical $*OR*$ of three or more logical values in the same manner:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/661f67f4b56b351d145dce2e9a87cd7c5f6a4d64.png) where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7bcdd7440cc300269a3395fa037d5af6351c3221.png) is equal to $1$ if some $*a*_{*i*} = 1$, otherwise it is equal to $0$.

Nam has a matrix $*A*$ consisting of $*m*$ rows and $*n*$ columns. The rows are numbered from $1$ to $*m*$, columns are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$. Element at row $*i*$ ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *m*$) and column $*j*$ ($1 ≤ *j* ≤ *n*$) is denoted as $*A*_{*ij*}$. All elements of $*A*$ are either 0 or 1. From matrix $*A*$, Nam creates another matrix $*B*$ of the same size using formula:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4332dfa4828fa3b9679abe53387834c43c801689.png).

($*B*_{*ij*}$ is $*OR*$ of all elements in row $*i*$ and column $*j*$ of matrix $*A*$)

Nam gives you matrix $*B*$ and challenges you to guess matrix $*A*$. Although Nam is smart, he could probably make a mistake while calculating matrix $*B*$, since size of $*A*$ can be large.

## Input

The first line contains two integer $*m*$ and $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *m*, *n* ≤ 100$), number of rows and number of columns of matrices respectively.

The next $*m*$ lines each contain $*n*$ integers separated by spaces describing rows of matrix $*B*$ (each element of $*B*$ is either $0$ or $1$).

## Output

In the first line, print "`NO`" if Nam has made a mistake when calculating $*B*$, otherwise print "`YES`". If the first line is "`YES`", then also print $*m*$ rows consisting of $*n*$ integers representing matrix $*A*$ that can produce given matrix $*B*$. If there are several solutions print any one.
statementZhMd:
让我们定义逻辑 $*OR*$ 为对两个逻辑值（即属于集合 ${0, 1}$ 的值）进行的一种运算：如果两个逻辑值中至少有一个为 $1$，则结果为 $1$；否则结果为 $0$。我们可以用相同的方式定义三个或更多逻辑值的逻辑 $*OR*$：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/661f67f4b56b351d145dce2e9a87cd7c5f6a4d64.png) 其中，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7bcdd7440cc300269a3395fa037d5af6351c3221.png) 表示如果存在某个 $*a*_{*i*} = 1$，则其值为 $1$，否则其值为 $0$。

Nam 有一个由 $*m*$ 行和 $*n*$ 列组成的矩阵 $*A*$。行编号从 $1$ 到 $*m*$，列编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。第 $*i*$ 行（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *m*$）第 $*j*$ 列（$1 ≤ *j* ≤ *n*$）的元素记为 $*A*_{*ij*}$。$*A*$ 中的所有元素均为 $0$ 或 $1$。Nam 根据以下公式从矩阵 $*A*$ 构造出一个大小相同的矩阵 $*B*$：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4332dfa4828fa3b9679abe53387834c43c801689.png)

（$*B*_{*ij*}$ 是矩阵 $*A*$ 的第 $*i*$ 行和第 $*j*$ 列中所有元素的 $*OR*$。）

Nam 将矩阵 $*B*$ 交给你，并要求你猜出矩阵 $*A*$。虽然 Nam 很聪明，但由于 $*A*$ 的规模可能很大，他在计算矩阵 $*B*$ 时可能会出错。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*m*$ 和 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *m*, *n* ≤ 100$），分别表示矩阵的行数和列数。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数，描述矩阵 $*B*$ 的一行（$*B*$ 中的每个元素均为 $0$ 或 $1$）。

## 输出格式

如果 Nam 在计算 $*B*$ 时出错，第一行输出 `NO`；否则输出 `YES`。如果第一行输出的是 `YES`，还需要输出 $*m*$ 行，每行包含 $*n*$ 个整数，表示一个能够生成给定矩阵 $*B*$ 的矩阵 $*A*$。如果有多个解，输出任意一个即可。
